headline: Weathered Expanse Reaches Parity as Nevish Line Suffers Mass Attrition
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has swung back into strict parity over the past three hours, where nine base clashes in the latest watch restored Warden standing to three strongholds against three Colonial holdings and three neutral ruins. In Linn of Mercy, four fresh transactions around Lathair and Outwich Ranch sustained intense fighting, though Colonials preserve ten positions against a solitary neutral site as Warden casualties mounted past one hundred and eighty in two hours. Nevish Line erupted into the morning's deadliest slaughter, devouring over nineteen hundred combined dead in two hours alongside two base handovers across contested ground. Mooring County recorded further friction at The Wind Hills, leaving the hex divided eleven bases to one in Warden favor. Further east, Stlican Shelf broke its prior quiet with an exchange at Briar, whereas Marban Hollow's split sector went cold without a turnover in two hours. Heavy attrition also gathered pace in Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage, signaling broad front-line strain as both sides commit fresh reserves to the meatgrinder.
